profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Developer that is passionate about learning and teaching topics in Software Engineering and Computer Science.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Strengthened the knowledge of students by delivering a deeper understanding in Memory Management, Advanced Data Structures, and Algorithm Complexity.

• Hosted labs and personal office hours four days a week to mentor students with coding assignments and other course content.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Operated in a Scrum workflow to complete assigned tasks and generated a 3-4% increase on average burndown, as reported on Azure DevOps burndown charts.

• Implemented a new webpage with React.js to allow Admins to interactively set discounts on existing goods and resulted in 100% satisfaction from all Sales Admins.

• Saved the Fraud Prevention Team 10-20 minutes time spent, when using the fraudulent payment filters webpage, by redesigning old C# (ASP.NET) and SQL Server code to allow multiple fraudulent email fields per filter instead of only one.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built onto and enhanced a complex ERP system written in C# (.NET), SQL Server, and DevExpress an advanced desktop application framework.

• Initiated a standalone project saving a potential 20k a year for clients by automating receptionist tasks coded in C# (.NET, DevExpress) and SQL Server.

positions.title: Customer Service
positions.description:
• Provided primary customer support to customers in a fast-paced environment.

• Helped develop and participated in several marketing ideas.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Debbie's Dream Foundation: Curing Stomach Cancer
volunteerExperiences.description:
• Participated in fundraising activities and collaborated in team meetings to identify new opportunities.

• Provided support and companionship to patients in need of assistance.

company.name: Debbie's Dream Foundation: Curing Stomach Cancer
